title: Interaction Inventory sidecar
description: The machine-readable half of an Interaction Inventory (Sheerline area 4). Consumed by microcopy-states-writer (copy_slot rows), heyhi-figjam-mapper (transitions as a stateDiagram), and later heyhi-prototype-audit / heyhi-figma-ds-generator. The judgment and gate blocks ship null by construction; a sidecar with a filled verdict fails pre-flight. copy_slot.string is null when this skill writes it and typed 'string | null' (v0.1.2), so a sidecar with area 3's microcopy-states-writer strings merged back still validates. HeyHi Confidential.

schema_version.description: 1.1 (2026-09-12) adds the optional surface-level missing_by_fidelity object. Backward-compatible: 1.0 sidecars (which lack that optional field) still validate, so both versions are accepted; new runs stamp 1.1.

missing_by_fidelity.description: Optional, surface-level (v1.1). When an entire state class is unshowable for EVERY element of the surface because the artifact has no mechanism to render it (no async path anywhere; no :active rule at all in the source), those cells are MISSING-by-fidelity: reported once here with a count, not as N per-element MISSING rows. Per-element MISSING (by omission) stays in elements[].states. Additive and optional, so a schema_version 1.0 sidecar without this field still validates.

keyboard.description: The APG pattern the keyboard interaction was taken from, e.g. 'per APG "Tabs"' — the pattern name only, or 'native <element>' for a native control; the interaction itself is read from the map at build, never copied into the sidecar.

source.description: Where the status came from: shown => from-source (read from the design/build); missing => inferred (applicability inferred from the element class; nothing read); n/a => n/a. A state with source inferred is never status shown.

taxonomy_slot.description: The 8+2 UX-writing taxonomy in heyhi-skills/voice-system-author/references/voice-system-template.md Part 3, enumerated here ONLY as a validation guard (a deliberate coupling — a rename in the template must be mirrored here; canon § 8).

string.description: Null when written by interaction-inventory (this skill still always writes null). Area 3's microcopy-states-writer fills it with a non-null candidate string; the widened type ('string | null', v0.1.2) lets a sidecar with those strings merged back validate against this schema. Seam agreement item 4, decision-log 2026-09-05. That copy_slot widening was backward-compatible and did not itself bump schema_version; schema_version later reached 1.1 (v0.1.3, 2026-09-12) for the optional surface-level missing_by_fidelity field, and 1.0 remains accepted (every null-string sidecar still validates).

judgment.description: Ships empty by construction. The human fills these in the markdown inventory at the named gate; a sidecar written by the skill carries null / [] here.
